68900.grammar: ger of virājeti, neg, caus, trans (+acc)

examples.text: hitvā agāraṃ pabbajitā, hitvā puttaṃ pasuṃ viyaṃ, hitvā rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca, avijjañ'ca virājiya, khīṇ'āsavā arahanto, te lokasmiṃ anussukā'ti.

68901.grammar: pr, caus of na virajjati, neg, trans (+acc or +loc)
68901.meaning1: detaches; loses interest (in); loses desire (for); makes indifferent (to)

examples.text: evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā pathavīdhātuyā nibbindati, pathavīdhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.

sa kho so, byagghapajjā, ariyasāvako iminā ca sīlapārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgena samannāgato iminā ca cittapārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgena samannāgato iminā ca diṭṭhipārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgena samannāgato rajanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ virājeti, vimocanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ vimoceti.

68902.grammar: pr, caus of na virajjati, neg, trans (+acc)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, gahapati, gijjho vā kaṅko vā kulalo vā maṃsapesiṃ ādāya uḍḍīyeyya. tam'enaṃ gijjhā'pi kaṅkā'pi kulalā'pi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitaccheyyuṃ virājeyyuṃ.

68903.grammar: abs of virājeti, neg, caus, trans (+acc)
68903.meaning1: having cleansed; having purified; having removed
68903.meaning2: having discarded, having removed, having destroyed

examples.text: devayānaṃ abhiruyha, virajaṃ so mahāpathaṃ, kāmarāgaṃ virājetvā, brahmalok'ūpago ahu, na naṃ jāti nivāresi, brahmalok'ūpapattiyā.
pañca kāmaguṇā loke, manochaṭṭhā paveditā, ettha chandaṃ virājetvā, evaṃ dukkhā pamuccatī'ti.

68904.grammar: abs of virājeti, neg, caus, trans (+acc)
68904.meaning1: having detached; having lost interest (in); having lost desire (for); having made indifferent (to)
68904.commentary: (ANa) virājetvā'ti ettha maggakkhaṇe virājeti nāma, phalakkhaṇe virattaṃ nāma hoti. dutiyapade'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: so rajanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ virājetvā, vimocanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ vimocetvā sammāvimuttiṃ phusati. ayaṃ vuccati, byagghapajjā, vimuttipārisuddhi.

68906.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from virādheti, neg, caus
68906.commentary: (DNa) ārādhanā'ti sampādanā. virādhanā'ti asampādanā. (DNt) sampādanā'ti maggassa upasampādanaṃ tassa sampāpanaṃ samma'd'eva pāpanaṃ. virādhanā'ti anārādhanā anupāyapaṭipatti.

examples.text: kathaṃ ārādhanā hoti, kathaṃ hoti virādhanā, iti puṭṭhā na sampāyanti, magge paṭipadāsu ca.

68907.grammar: imp 2nd sg of virādhayatu, neg, caus, trans (+acc)

examples.text: mayūrakoñc'ābhirutamhi kānane, dīpīhi byagghehi purakkhato vasaṃ, kāye apekkhaṃ jaha mā virādhaya, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.

68908.grammar: pr, caus of virajjhati, neg, trans (+acc)

examples.text: mayūrakoñc'ābhirutamhi kānane, dīpīhi byagghehi purakkhato vasaṃ, kāye apekkhaṃ jaha mā virādhaya, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.

68909.grammar: aor of virādhayati, neg, caus, trans (+acc)
68909.meaning1: missed; failed to attain; did not succeed (in)

examples.text: yo papañcam'anuyutto, papañc'ābhirato mago, virādhayī so nibbānaṃ, yogakkhemaṃ anuttaraṃ.

68910.grammar: abs of virādhayati, neg, caus, trans (+acc)
68910.commentary: (NIDD1) kammavirādhayitvā'ti puññ'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ vā apuññ'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ vā āneñj'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ vā viraddhaṃ mayā, aparaddhaṃ mayā, khalitaṃ mayā, galitaṃ mayā, aññāya aparaddho ahan'ti vedhati pavedhati sampavedhatī'ti, pavedhati kammavirādhayitvā. (SNPa) so taṃ sīlabbat'ādi-kammaṃ puññ'ābhisaṅkhār'ādi-kammaṃ vā virādhayitvā pavedhatī.

examples.text: sace cuto sīlavatato hoti, pavedhatī kamma virādhayitvā, pajappatī patthayatī ca suddhiṃ, satthā'va hīno pavasaṃ gharamhā.

68911.commentary: (THa) kiñ'c'āpi te, citta, virādhitaṃ mayā'ti, ambho citta, kiṃ nāma te mayā viraddhaṃ, taṃ kathehī'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: nanu dubbhissasi maṃ punappunaṃ, muhuṃ muhuṃ cāraṇikaṃ'va dassayaṃ, ummattaken'eva mayā palobhasi, kiñ'c'āpi te citta virādhitaṃ mayā.

68913.grammar: pr, caus of virajjhati, neg, trans (+acc)
68913.meaning1: misses; loses hold; fails to grasp
68913.commentary: (MNa) virādheyyā'ti hatthena gahaṇayutte vā pādena patiṭṭhānayutte vā ṭhāne gahaṇapatiṭṭhānāni kātuṃ na sakkuṇeyya.

examples.text: sace kho tvaṃ, bhikkhu, brahmuno vacanaṃ upātivattissasi… seyyathā'pi vā pana, bhikkhu, puriso narakappapāte papatanto hatthehi ca pādehi ca pathaviṃ virādheyya, evaṃ sampadam'idaṃ, bhikkhu, tuyhaṃ bhavissati.

68914.grammar: abs of virādheti, neg, caus, trans (+acc)
68914.meaning2: having missed, having omitted, having failed

68915.grammar: aor of virādheti, neg, caus, trans (+acc)

examples.text: bhuttassa ca sūkaramaddavena, byādhippabāḷho udapādi satthuno, viriccamāno bhagavā avoca, gacchām'ahaṃ kusināraṃ nagaran'ti.
bhuttassa ca sūkaramaddavena, byādhippabāḷho udapādi satthuno, viriñcamāno bhagavā avoca, gacchām'ahaṃ kusināraṃ nagaran'ti.

68921.commentary: (DNa) na vīriyaṃ ārabhatī'ti duvidham'pi vīriyaṃ n'ārabhati. appattassā'ti jhāna-vipassanā-maggaphala-dhammassa appattassa pattiyā. anadhigatassā'ti tass'eva anadhigatassa adhigam'atthāya. asacchikatassā'ti tass'eva apaccakkhakatassa sacchikaraṇ'atthāya. (MNa) vīrabhāvato vidhinā īrayitabbato ca vīriyaṃ. taṃ paggahalakkhaṇaṃ, upatthambhanarasaṃ, anosīdanapaccupaṭṭhānaṃ.

examples.text: n'atthi balaṃ, n'atthi viriyaṃ, n'atthi purisathāmo, n'atthi purisaparakkamo, sabbe sattā sabbe pāṇā sabbe bhūtā sabbe jīvā avasā abalā avīriyā niyatisaṃgatibhāvapariṇatā chasv'ev'ābhijātīsu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī'ti.

68922.meaning1: highest state of effort; perfection of energy

68923.meaning1: power that is effort; strength of energy

examples.text: katamāni pañca? saddhābalaṃ, hiribalaṃ, ottappabalaṃ, viriyabalaṃ, paññābalaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca sekhabalāni.

68925.commentary: (THa) so vīriyavā āraddhavīriyo akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāyā'ti attho.

examples.text: paripuṇṇakāyo suruci, sujāto cārudassano, suvaṇṇavaṇṇo'si bhagavā, susukkadāṭho'si viriyavā.

n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yena anuppannā vā kusalā dhammā uppajjanti uppannā vā akusalā dhammā parihāyanti yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave viriy'ārambho. āraddhavīriyassa, bhikkhave, anuppannā c'eva kusalā dhammā uppajjanti uppannā ca akusalā dhammā parihāyantī'ti.

68928.meaning1: is blocked; is obstructed; is opposed (by)

examples.text: pathavisamo no virujjhati, indakhīl'ūpamo tādi subbato, rahado'va apetakaddamo, saṃsārā na bhavanti tādino.
tath'eva isayo hiṃsaṃ, saññate brahmacārino, adhammacārī khattiyo, so saggena virujjhati.

68929.meaning1: is contrary; is contradictory; is opposite in meaning (to)

examples.text: paṇḍitapaṭirūpakānañ'hi santike kathetuṃ dukkhaṃ hoti, te pade pade akkhare akkhare dosam'eva vadanti. ek'antapaṇḍitā pana kathaṃ sutvā sukathitaṃ pasaṃsanti, dukkathite pāḷipada-attha-byañjanesu yaṃ yaṃ virujjhati, taṃ taṃ ujuṃ katvā denti.

68933.commentary: (NIDD1) virutañ'ca… virutaṃ vuccati migavākkaṃ. migavākkapāṭhakā migavākkaṃ ādisanti, sakuntānaṃ vā catuppadānaṃ vā rutaṃ vassitaṃ jānantī'ti. evaṃ migavākkapāṭhakā migavākkaṃ ādisanti.

examples.text: āthabbaṇaṃ supinaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ, no vidahe atho'pi nakkhattaṃ, virutañ'ca gabbhakaraṇaṃ, tikicchaṃ māmako na seveyya.

68934.meaning1: hostile; opposed; in opposition; (comm) obstructed by hostility and anger

examples.text: aviruddhaṃ viruddhesu, attadaṇḍesu nibbutaṃ, sādānesu anādānaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
ye viruddhā sallapanti, viniviṭṭhā samussitā, anariyaguṇam'āsajja, añño'ññavivar'esino.

68936.meaning1: (comm) giving medicine to revive a stillbirth
68936.commentary: (DNa) viruddhagabbhakaraṇan'ti viruddhassa vilīnassa aṭṭhitassa matassa gabbhassa karaṇaṃ. puna avināsāya bhesajjadānan'ti attho. gabbho hi vātena, pāṇakehi, kammunā cā'ti tīhi kāraṇehi vinassati. tattha vātena vinassante nibbāpanīyaṃ sītalaṃ bhesajjaṃ deti, pāṇakehi vinassante pāṇakānaṃ paṭikammaṃ karoti, kammunā vinassante pana buddhā'pi paṭibāhituṃ na sakkonti.

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, āvāhanaṃ vivāhanaṃ saṃvaraṇaṃ vivaraṇaṃ saṃkiraṇaṃ vikiraṇaṃ subhagakaraṇaṃ dubbhagakaraṇaṃ viruddhagabbhakaraṇaṃ jivhānibandhanaṃ hanusaṃhananaṃ hatth'ābhijappanaṃ

68938.meaning1: (of a wound) heals; cures; grows over

examples.text: tassa imissā ca sappāyakiriyāya asuci visadoso apanīto anupādiseso tadubhayena vaṇo viruheyya.

68939.synonym: udeti, pabbati, pavaḍḍhati, vaḍḍhati, vaḍḍheti, vaddhati

examples.text: atha kho taṃ, bhikkhave, māluvābījaṃ n'eva moro gileyya, na mago khādeyya, na davaḍāho ḍaheyya, na vanakammikā uddhareyyuṃ, na upacikā uṭṭhaheyyuṃ, bījañ'ca pan'assa taṃ pāvussakena meghena abhippavuṭṭhaṃ samma'd'eva viruheyya.

68941.meaning1: in the sense of the place of growth

examples.text: te atthaladdhā sukhitā, viruḷhā buddhasāsane, arogā sukhitā hotha, saha sabbehi ñātibhī'ti.

68943.commentary: (ANa) virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjantī'ti sīl'ādīhi guṇehi vaḍḍhanato vuddhiṃ, niccalabhāvena virūḷhiṃ, sabbattha patthaṭatāya vepullaṃ pāpuṇanti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, tālo matthakacchinno abhabbo puna viruḷhiyā.
apagatā ca te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmā dhammavinayā, na ca te imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ viruḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjanti.

68944.commentary: (THa) virūpo'ti tena muṇḍabhāvena parūḷhalomatāya chinnabhinnakāsāya vatthatāya virūpo vevaṇṇiyaṃ upagato.

examples.text: muṇḍo virūpo abhisāpam'āgato, kapālahattho'va kulesu bhikkhasu, yuñjassu satthuvacane mah'esino, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.

68945.meaning1: name of a royal family of serpents

examples.text: sace hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phareyya, na hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālaṅ'kareyya. katamāni cattāri? virūp'akkhaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, erāpathaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, chabyāputtaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, kaṇhāgotamakaṃ ahirājakulaṃ.

68946.meaning1: name of one of the Four Great Kings
68946.meaning2: name of the overlord of Nāgas
68946.commentary: (DNa) virūp'akkho nāgarājā nāgānaṃ koṭisatasahassena parivuto koṭisatasahassamaṇimayāni mahāphalakāni ca suvaṇṇasattiyo ca gāhāpetvā pacchimāya disāya puratthim'ābhimukho dvīsu devalokesu devatā purato katvā nisinno.

examples.text: pacchimāya disāya virūp'akkho mahārājā puratth'ābhimukho nisinno hoti deve purakkhatvā, uttarāya disāya vessavaṇo mahārājā dakkhiṇābhimukho nisinno hoti deve purakkhatvā.

68948.grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr sg of virūparūpa
68948.meaning1: in different ways; in various ways; differently
68948.meaning2: in different ways; in various ways; differently

examples.text: kāmāhi citrā madhurā manoramā, virūparūpena mathenti cittaṃ, ādīnavaṃ kāmaguṇesu disvā, tasmā ahaṃ pabbajitomhi rāja.

68949.synonym: udeti, pabbati, pavaḍḍhati, vaḍḍhati, vaḍḍheti, vaddhati

examples.text: kuhā thaddhā lapā siṅgī, unnaḷā asamāhitā, na te dhamme virūhanti, sammāsambuddhadesite.
nikkuhā nillapā dhīrā, atthaddhā susamāhitā, te ve dhamme virūhanti, sammāsambuddhadesite'ti.
tato amatam'ādāya, abhisiñci mahīruhaṃ, tassa sākhā virūhiṃsu, sītacchāyā manoramā.

68954.meaning2: having grown, having sprouted, having increased

examples.text: kabaḷīkāre ce, bhikkhave, āhāre atthi rāgo atthi nandī atthi taṇhā, patiṭṭhitaṃ tattha viññāṇaṃ virūḷhaṃ. yattha patiṭṭhitaṃ viññāṇaṃ virūḷhaṃ, atthi tattha nāmarūpassa avakkanti.

68956.meaning1: name of one of the Four Great Kings
68956.commentary: (DNa) virūḷho taṃ pasāsatī'ti taṃ disaṃ virūḷho anusāsati.

examples.text: dakkhiṇañ'ca disaṃ rājā, virūḷho taṃ pasāsati, kumbhaṇḍānaṃ adhipati, mahārājā yasassiso.

68957.meaning1: name of one of the Four Great Kings
68957.meaning2: name of one of the Four Great Kings
68957.construction:
vi + √ruh + ta > rūḍha > rūḷha + ka
virūḷha + ka
68957.commentary: (DNa) virūḷhako kumbhaṇḍarājā kumbhaṇḍadevatānaṃ koṭisatasahassena parivuto koṭisatasahassarajatamayāni phalakāni ca suvaṇṇasattiyo ca gāhāpetvā dakkhiṇāya disāya uttar'ābhimukho dvīsu devalokesu devatā purato katvā nisinno.

examples.text: idh'āhaṃ, bhante, vessavaṇena mahārājena pesito virūḷhakassa mahārājassa santike kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena addasaṃ bhagavantaṃ antarāmagge giñjakāvasathaṃ pavisitvā māgadhake paricārake ārabbha aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasikatvā sabbaṃ cetasā samannāharitvā nisinnaṃ
upayo, bhikkhave, avimutto, anupayo vimutto. rūp'upayaṃ vā, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, rūp'ārammaṇaṃ rūpappatiṭṭhaṃ nand'ūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.
tassa so bhisakko sallakatto bhesajjaṃ kareyya, uddhaṃvirecanaṃ adhovirecanaṃ añjanaṃ paccañjanaṃ natthukammaṃ. so taṃ bhesajjaṃ āgamma cakkhūni uppādeyya, cakkhūni visodheyya.

68961.construction:
vi + rece + ana + ka
virecana + ka

68962.notes: A corrupt reading, the correct spelling of the causative would be virecemāno.

examples.text: bhuttassa ca sūkaramaddavena, byādhippabāḷho udapādi satthuno, virecamāno bhagavā avoca, gacchām'ahaṃ kusināraṃ nagaran'ti.

68968.meaning1: shines brightly; is brilliant; is radiant (among)

examples.text: sabbhi'r'eva samāsetha, sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ, sataṃ saddhammam'aññāya, ñātimajjhe virocatī'ti.
seyyathā'pi nāma maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭh'aṃso suparikammakato paṇḍukambale nikkhitto bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca
yāvatā candimasūriyā, pariharanti disā bhanti virocanā. tāva sahassadhā loko, ettha te vattate vaso.
yāvatā, bhikkhave, candimasūriyā pariharanti disā bhanti virocamānā, tāva sahassadhā loko.
padumaṃ yathā kokanadaṃ sugandhaṃ, pāto siyā phullam'avītagandhaṃ, aṅgīrasaṃ passa virocamānaṃ, tapantam'ādiccam'iv'antalikkhe'ti.

68971.commentary: (SNPa) virocasi vimalo'ti dhūmaraj'ādivirahito viya cando, rāg'ādimal'ābhāvena vimalo virocasi. (PVa) virocasī'ti virājesi. (THa) ādicco'va virocasī'ti yathā ādicco uggacchanto sabbaṃ tamagataṃ vidhametvā ālokaṃ karonto virocati, evaṃ tvam'pi anto c'eva bahi ca sabbaṃ avijjātamaṃ viddhaṃsetvā ñāṇ'ālokaṃ karonto virocasi.

examples.text: pasannanetto sumukho, brahā uju patāpavā, majjhe samaṇasaṅghassa, ādicco'va virocasi.
bhagavā'pi therassa saha dassanen'eva sarīr'obhāsaṃ muñci, asīti-anubyañjana-virājitā byāmappabhā pasāritasuvaṇṇapaṭo viya virocittha.
rasañ'ca bhotvāna asāditañ'ca sāduṃ, atho'pi bhotvāna asādum'ekadā, sāduṃ rasaṃ n'ājjhosāya bhuñje, virodham'āsādusu n'opadaṃsaye.
tass'ānurodhā atha vā virodhā, vidhūpitā atthagatā na santi, padañ'ca ñatvā virajaṃ asokaṃ, sammā pajānāti bhavassa pāragū'ti.

acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante! yatra hi nāma satthu c'eva sāvikāya ca atthena attho byañjanena byañjanaṃ saṃsandissati, samessati, na virodhayissati yadidaṃ aggapadasmiṃ. handa dāni mayaṃ, bhante, gacchāma.

68984.meaning2: having rendered hostile, having caused obstruction

68986.meaning1: fact of having distinct characteristics; fact of varying in character

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma purisassa ayosiṅghāṭakaṃ kaṇṭhe vilaggaṃ, so n'eva sakkuṇeyya uggilituṃ na sakkuṇeyya ogilituṃ. evam'eva kho te, rājakumāra, samaṇo gotamo imaṃ ubhatokoṭikaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno n'eva sakkhiti uggilituṃ na sakkhiti ogilitun'ti.

68990.construction:
vi + laṅgha + a + ka
vilaṅgha + ka

examples.text: sac'assa hoti avisayhaṃ, hatthavikārena dutiyaṃ āmantetvā hatthavilaṅghakena upaṭṭhāpema, na tv'eva mayaṃ, bhante, tappaccayā vācaṃ bhindāma
yaññ'atthaṃ vā dhan'atthaṃ vā, ye hanāma mayaṃ pure, avase taṃ bhayaṃ hoti, vedhanti vilapanti ca.
taṃ maṃ tato satthavāho, ussannāya vipulāya vaḍḍhiyā, okaḍḍhati vilapantiṃ, acchinditvā kulagharasmā.
evaṃ vilapamānaṃ taṃ, ānandaṃ āha gotamī, sutasāgaragambhīra, buddh'opaṭṭhānatappara.

68998.meaning1: talked nonsense; babbled incoherently; spoke rubbish (about)
68998.commentary: (VIN 1.1.4) tucchaṃ musā vilapin'ti tucchakaṃ mayā bhaṇitaṃ, musā mayā bhaṇitaṃ, abhūtaṃ mayā bhaṇitaṃ, ajānantena mayā bhaṇitaṃ. (JAa) mā bāliyaṃ vilapī'ti mā attano bālabhāvaṃ vippalapasi

examples.text: ajānam'evaṃ āvuso avacaṃ jānāmi, apassaṃ passāmi, tucchaṃ musā vilapin'ti, aññatra adhimānā, ayam'pi pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
mā bāliyaṃ vilapi na hi'ssa tādisaṃ, viḍayhase na hi labhase nisedhakaṃ, āsajjasi gajam'iva ekacārinaṃ, yo taṃ padā naḷam'iva pothayissatī'ti.

68999.meaning1: talked nonsense; spoken rubbish; babbled incoherently

examples.text: tiṭṭhat'esā, bho gotama, amhākañ'c'eva aññesañ'ca puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ vācā. vilāpaṃ vilapitaṃ maññe.
